verdict.rationale: Bugbot is documented as analyzing every PR for bugs and security vulnerabilities, with inline explanations and fixes. Cursor reports high effort finds 35% more bugs at an 80% resolution rate. Independent hands-on users say it 'finds genuine bugs most reviewers miss', that 'almost none of its comments are frivolous', and call it 'shockingly effective'. One user did see it flip-flop, re-recommending a fix after arguing for its reversion, which dents consistency but does not contradict the bug-finding claim. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence for specific bug classes such as race conditions or edge cases, and no independent benchmark of precision vs. style-nit noise.
